sourceFindings.publicInitTexture: WebGLRenderer initTexture public documentation explicitly describes preloading to avoid decode/GPU upload lag; method routes through normal WebGLTextures setters and unbinds texture state.
sourceFindings.compileAsync: Public compileAsync traverses material programs and waits for readiness. It does not ordinarily initialize material maps. Existing World mandatory final compileAsync must remain.
sourceFindings.sharing: WebGLTextures maps Source to GPU textures keyed by14 sampler/format/color-space fields. Upload occurs on changed Source version or forced new sampler-key allocation. Source identity alone cannot authorize skipping init.
sourceFindings.scopeLimit: A single large texSubImage2D remains synchronous and indivisible through public initTexture. Warming offscreen roots could create additional GPU residency/work; no global activation justified without foreground eligibility and measured memory/load evidence.
